name.value: Al Baraka Specialty Foods & Bakery LTD

description.value: Al Baraka is a small convenience store in Surrey specializing in high-quality halal meat and Middle Eastern groceries, including fresh-baked Iraqi bread available daily and pita bread five days a week. The shop also stocks frozen traditional Iraqi food alongside everyday convenience items like snacks, soft drinks, toiletries, and tobacco products. A touring cyclist looking for halal provisions or culturally specific Middle Eastern staples in the Surrey area would find this a unique stop.
